sections.tldr: MAHE Online MBA in Logistics & Supply Chain Management covers supply chain management, logistics fundamentals, operations management, quality management, procurement, and logistics distribution. NAAC A++ NIRF University #3 with IoE tag. Work experience required; fresh graduates submit SOP video.

about.body:
MAHE's Online MBA in Logistics & Supply Chain Management covers end-to-end supply chain planning, procurement, and distribution. Semester 4 adds quality management in logistics and supply chain (ISO standards for logistics, Six Sigma in warehousing, KPI dashboards for supply chain performance), procurement and purchasing (strategic sourcing, vendor evaluation, contract negotiation, e-procurement), and logistics and distribution management (last-mile delivery optimisation, route planning, cold chain logistics, reverse logistics).

The dedicated logistics focus sets this apart from generic operations MBAs.

MAHE holds NIRF University #3, NAAC A++, and Institution of Eminence status. The NIRF University #3 with large logistics firms and FMCG companies that filter on university rank.

Work experience in reputed organisations is required. Fresh graduates can apply with an SOP video.

whoHires.body:
**Industries:** E-commerce logistics, FMCG distribution, manufacturing supply chain, third-party logistics (3PL), pharmaceutical logistics, cold chain, automotive, and retail

**Entry-level roles:** Supply Chain Analyst, Logistics Coordinator, Procurement Executive, Warehouse Operations Associate, Demand Planner, Transportation Analyst

**Mid-level roles:** Supply Chain Manager, Logistics Manager, Procurement Manager, Warehouse Manager, Demand Planning Manager, Distribution Head

**Senior roles:** VP Supply Chain, Chief Procurement Officer, Head of Logistics, Director of Distribution, Supply Chain Director, COO

**How to check placement claims:** ask Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) Online for its latest placement report in writing, for your programme and mode. Online batches are often reported apart from campus ones, or not at all. edifyedu.in does not publish employer lists it cannot source. Treat the roles above as the kinds of jobs this syllabus prepares you for, not as a list of who has hired from this batch.

skills.body:
The Logistics & SCM specialisation builds skills across supply chain strategy, logistics execution, and procurement:

- Supply Chain Planning: demand forecasting methods, EOQ/safety stock calculation, supply chain network optimisation, and bullwhip effect mitigation
- Logistics: warehouse layout design, transportation mode selection, route optimisation, 3PL/4PL evaluation, and cold chain management
- Procurement: strategic sourcing methodology, vendor scorecard design, TCO analysis, and contract drafting
- Quality: ISO audit preparation for logistics, Six Sigma application in warehouse operations, and supply chain KPI dashboard design

- Distribution: last-mile delivery strategy, reverse logistics programme design, omni-channel fulfilment planning
- Operations: capacity planning, production scheduling, and lean waste elimination

**Soft skills:** Negotiating with suppliers, managing cross-functional SCM teams, presenting supply chain cost-reduction proposals to leadership, and coordinating multi-stakeholder logistics operations.

certificate.body:
Graduates receive an MBA degree certificate with Logistics & Supply Chain Management as the specialisation, issued by Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) under UGC-DEB 2020 online mode standards.

The degree carries NAAC A++ accreditation, NIRF University #3, Institution of Eminence status, and WES recognition. Valid for supply chain leadership promotions, PSU logistics roles, MNC procurement positions, and private-sector operations recruitment. DigiLocker issuance is standard.

faqs.question: Does the programme cover both supply chain strategy and logistics execution?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sem 4 adds procurement, quality management, and distribution management covering last-mile and cold chain.

faqs.question: How does MAHE Logistics & SCM compare to MUJ SCM?
faqs.answer: Same platform, similar delivery. Choose MAHE if the flagship brand specifically matters for large logistics employers. Choose MUJ if fee value is the priority.

faqs.question: Is cold chain logistics covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Logistics and Distribution Management subject in Sem 4 covers cold chain logistics, last-mile delivery optimisation, reverse logistics, and distribution centre design.
